profitMetric: Segment result before interest and tax
definition: Reported division profit before finance costs, company-wide items that are not assigned to a division, and income tax.
location: NSE digital annual filing, audited year to date ended 31 March 2026, Financial Results and Segment Revenue and Result tables.
notes: The source reports no interdivision revenue adjustment. Total segment result was ₹2,601.70 crore. Subtract ₹40.58 crore finance costs and ₹261.60 crore net unallocated expense to reach ₹2,299.51 crore profit before tax, allowing for rounding. The company reported ₹1,685.09 crore profit after tax.
insight: Home Appliances and Air Solution brought in more sales and segment profit. Home Entertainment kept a larger share of its division’s sales as segment result.
